discovery_notes: Follow-up 10 of B037 (DLP 2015). 30 WebSearch calls, all search_snippet, blocked domains passed. Reuses 330-411 keys. New: 3 Jan, 3 Feb, 4 Mar, 2 Nov OE pins from dein-dlrp overview lines; 2 Alice event pins (hold). No holds released.
